description: This file provides utility functions for making HTTP requests to a backend API, including constructing API URLs, performing fetch requests with optional authorization tokens, parsing JSON responses safely, and handling file downloads.

methods.name: withNoTrailingSlash(url)
methods.description: Removes trailing slash from a URL if present.

methods.name: getApiBase()
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL from environment variables, removing any trailing slash.

methods.name: apiUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a full API URL by appending the provided path to the base URL, adding '/api' prefix if necessary.

methods.name: safeJsonParse(text)
methods.description: Safely parses a JSON string, returning null if parsing fails.

methods.name: readBody(res)
methods.description: Reads the response body as text and attempts to parse it as JSON.

methods.name: apiRequest(path, { method = "GET", token = "", body = null, headers = {} } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the specified API path with options for method, token, body, and headers.

methods.name: apiDownload(path, { token = "" } = {})
methods.description: Downloads a file from the backend, returning its blob data and filename.

ctags.name: apiRequest
ctags.pattern: /^export async function apiRequest(path, { method = "GET", token = "", body = null, headers = {} }/
